hey i need help writing a rejection email for a candidate. they made it to the final round for a senior dev position but we decided to go with someone else. can you draft something professional and polite?

Here's a draft that keeps things warm but professional:

---

**Subject:** Update on Your Application — Senior Developer Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to interview with us for the Senior Developer position. We genuinely enjoyed our conversations and were impressed by your technical depth and the thoughtfulness you brought to each round.

After careful consideration, we've decided to move forward with another candidate whose experience more closely aligns with the specific needs of this role. This was a difficult decision — you were among a very strong group of finalists, and the choice came down to a close comparison rather than any shortcoming on your part.

We would love to keep your resume on file and reach out if a role opens up that better matches your background. We'd also welcome you to apply for future openings that catch your eye.

Thank you again for the time and energy you invested in this process. We wish you every success in your search.

Warm regards,
[Your Name]
[Title]
[Company]

---

A few notes on why it's built this way: the "close comparison" line matters a lot for final-round candidates — they know they were near the top of the pile, so a generic "we've decided to pursue other candidates
